animations.task_complete: scale 1.1 and return on checkbox to trigger dopamine response. Keep it fast and snappy.
animations.grounding_breathing: scale from 1 to 1.5 over 4 seconds, hold 4s, scale down over 4s (box breathing).
animations.general: Stagger list items on load, but strictly support prefers-reduced-motion.

motion_accessibility.accessibility: High contrast text, large tap areas, aria-labels for all interactive elements.

backgrounds.description: Calm body of water near mountain, use at 10-20% opacity as a full-screen background in the grounding/breathing section to reduce anxiety without distraction.
Minimalist green plant leaf, can be used as subtle background texture on the home screen or profile.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build this as a mobile-first responsive web app. Ensure the main layout is constrained to max-w-md and centered on desktop to mimic an Expo React Native mobile view (as this environment heavily favors standard React/Tailwind).
Install and use 'lucide-react' for all icons.
Install and use 'framer-motion' for the task completion feedback and the grounding box-breathing animation. Keep other animations minimal to avoid distracting ADHD users.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Manrope' for headings and 'Figtree' for body text. Load these from Google Fonts.

For the daily task list, ensure checking a task requires explicit physical tap (no auto-completion or swipe-to-complete, to avoid accidental triggers and guarantee mindfulness). On check, change the checkbox to Terracotta (#E07A5F) to give a visual dopamine reward.
Keep cognitive load low: don't crowd the calendar view. Show a single week horizontal strip at the top, and below it, the clearly delineated tasks for the selected day.
The 'Grounding' view must hide all navigation and take over the full screen, providing a distraction-free environment for the 5-4-3-2-1 exercise or breathing.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='task-checkbox', data-testid='add-task-btn', data-testid='grounding-start-btn').
The daily joke/fact should be presented clearly without blinking or autoplaying elements. Just static text in the designated card.
Avoid typical high-stress patterns: no red badges, no countdown timers, no overly dense data displays, no strict deadlines that induce anxiety.
